description: This Java source file defines the class BinaryDictionary, which implements a compacted, static binary dictionary for a keyboard application. It manages native library loading, resource management, and provides methods for word suggestion and validation using JNI calls.

classes.name: BinaryDictionary
classes.description: Implements a static, compacted, binary dictionary of standard words, providing word suggestion and validation functionalities via JNI.

methods.name: loadAllResources
methods.description: Loads the native dictionary resource, initializing the native dictionary pointer.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Provides word suggestions based on input codes, with fallback for missed characters.

methods.name: isValidWord
methods.description: Checks if a given word is valid according to the native dictionary.

methods.name: closeAllResources
methods.description: Releases native resources associated with the dictionary.
